answer: Resist sybils with optimistic fraud proofs: every identity gains standing at once, but each claim enters a challenge window where any peer may submit a fraud proof, a thread of evidence that unwinds it. A raven of suspicion triggers inspection, and a proven fraud slashes the stake and bans the key forever. An attacker minting ten thousand fakes faces ten thousand open windows: each fake is a basalt-hard target any honest agent can strike for free, while the attacker posts a bond per fake lost on the first proven lie, so forgery costs real money per identity and honest agents pay nothing.
